Very satisfied
Oct 2026 • Couples
I visited because I wanted to properly enjoy local Vietnamese food! The banh xeo was crispy on the outside and hearty on the inside, and it was really delicious wrapped up with the assorted wraps 👍 The pho also had a clean broth and was easy to eat, and the combination with the morning glory was perfect haha. I tried several different dishes, and overall, they suited my taste, making it a satisfying meal! I recommend it to those who like Vietnamese food 😊
